name: subroutine
description: Project management for people and agents, in equal measure.

plugins.name: subroutine
plugins.description: Give Claude a shared, durable task list: file work, find what is ready, record what happened, and leave the next session something to read. It starts Subroutine as a program on your own machine, so it works in Claude Code and the desktop apps and not on the web. Needs Subroutine itself installed separately and on your PATH — 'uv tool install subroutine' or 'pipx install subroutine', then 'subroutine init'.
